alt.en: A mounted ruler and attendants stand amid hills below manuscript text.
alt.zh: 手稿文字下，骑马的统治者与随从置身山丘之间。

caption.en: Timur before a battle in 1403, illustrated in a Zafarnama manuscript of 1436.
caption.zh: 1436年《胜利之书》手稿中描绘的帖木儿1403年战前场景。
